predictions.reasoning: This market concerns the criminal sentencing of Harvey Weinstein in his New York retrial. There is no publicly traded company, commodity, currency, or index whose cash flows or risk premia are materially exposed to whether his prison term exceeds 30 years. The Weinstein Company already collapsed into bankruptcy years ago; its assets were sold to Lantern Capital/Spyglass and there is no listed equity tied to the outcome. Any movement in the implied probability of this market therefore carries essentially no information about liquid asset prices. Manufacturing a link (e.g., media conglomerates, #MeToo-related sentiment) would be spurious given the idiosyncratic, single-person, backward-looking nature of the event.

llm_justification.summary: The market tracks Harvey Weinstein's criminal sentencing length, an idiosyncratic legal event with no material exposure to any liquid public-market asset. The relevant corporate entity (The Weinstein Company) is long bankrupt and delisted, so probability moves in this market leak no actionable asset-price information. The correct call is 'unclear' with very low confidence and no tradable signal (expected move far below the 700 bps threshold).
